title: The free-shipping gap
hook: Adding an item can remove shipping while raising the total you pay.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Compare total checkout cost when adding merchandise to reach a shipping threshold.

misconception: Free shipping means a lower checkout total.
objective: Compare total checkout cost when adding merchandise to reach a shipping threshold.

claims.text: Shipping costs €4 below €50. B adds exactly enough merchandise to reach €50. Scaled model; fictional policy; added goods optional.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Basket=42€, A=€46 and B=€50. The geometry pictures follow the declared dimension relationships; other stage pictures are scaled to the larger displayed comparison and icons are not literal item counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["+","x",["*",4,["-",1,["floor",["min",1,["/","x",50]]]]]]; B=["max","x",50]; x denotes Basket. At x=42, A=46, B=50; recall at x=45: B=50. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals.

claims.text: Removing a shipping line is not the same as reducing the whole receipt. At €42, shipping makes €46; reaching €50 adds €8 of goods. Compare totals before naming a saving.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["+","x",["*",4,["-",1,["floor",["min",1,["/","x",50]]]]]]; B=["max","x",50]; x denotes Basket. At x=42, A=46, B=50; recall at x=45: B=50. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. The principle follows from those expressions and stated scenario limits.

claims.text: Shipping costs €4 below €50. B adds exactly enough merchandise to reach €50. Change only Basket to 45€. What is B (Reach-threshold) now? Correct: €50. Use B's stated rule with Basket=45€: it gives €50. Removing a shipping line is not the same as reducing the whole receipt. At €42, shipping makes €46; reaching €50 adds €8 of goods. Compare totals before naming a saving.

recall.question: Shipping costs €4 below €50. B adds exactly enough merchandise to reach €50. Change only Basket to 45€. What is B (Reach-threshold) now?
recall.why: Use B's stated rule with Basket=45€: it gives €50. Removing a shipping line is not the same as reducing the whole receipt. At €42, shipping makes €46; reaching €50 adds €8 of goods. Compare totals before naming a saving.

safety.assumptions: Shipping costs €4 below €50. B adds exactly enough merchandise to reach €50.
safety.excluded: No chemical mixtures, medical advice, wiring, safety-device bypass, actual tariffs, financial recommendations, temperature, food-storage or food-safety instructions. All energy powers, durations and tariffs are illustrative.
